summary: LocalStorageBackend — backend implementation for the local filesystem. Composed of 7 operation modules: local_connection.py (connect/disconnect), local_read.py (read_to_stream via open()), local_write.py (write_from_bytes, write_from_stream), local_list.py (list_files, list_directories using pathlib), local_delete.py (delete_file), local_copy.py (copy via shutil), local_directory.py (mkdir, rmdir), local_metadata.py (path_exists, get_metadata, get_size). Implements all 8 storage protocols. Registered for CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE.LOCAL.
lifecycle_notes: Reference backend — most complete protocol implementation; used to validate protocol alignment tests
documentation_hooks: The local backend is the reference implementation for new backend authors to follow the protocol patterns

evidence.detail: Local backend verified against all 8 protocols
